game.description: Build and run your own hospital. Furnish rooms, develop staff, research better care, meet patient needs and take on emergency referrals on the way to three stars.

validation.engineCheck: Seven modules link; package passes 120 native headless frames with no warnings.
validation.native: 4,178-frame management playthrough passed at quantum and infinite; molecular management and cellular touch flows also passed.
validation.browser: Desktop research, staff training, room refits, policies and contract playthrough passed. Phone management controls and durable research/staff-pay restoration passed.
validation.saveCompatibility: Version 2.0 hospitals migrate in place without losing finances, rooms, staff or patients; expanded research and staff state survive browser reload.
validation.live: Published source modules and manifest match local bytes. Public desktop and phone load with no console errors or warnings.
